subject: apps/three-surface-poc/src/governance-inputs.test.ts > 'evaluates the three real current PWB acts without reading any body' timing out at the default 5 s under parallel load

diagnosis.cause: The production loader's default reader spawns one 'git cat-file blob' subprocess per governance blob; over the real tree that is 123 subprocesses (118 decision records scanned for lifecycle supersession, plus artifacts, act records and tagged records). About 1 s alone; process spawning degrades sharply under load.
diagnosis.whyNotHoist: The cost is in the one test that uses it, so a beforeAll would only move it into a hook with its own default timeout. A cheaper fixture (an injected batched reader) would replace the production reader this test exists to exercise over the real tree. The hermetic test 'preserves production Git blob bytes' covers the default reader on a small repository only.
diagnosis.fix: Explicit per-test timeout REAL_TREE_TIMEOUT_MS = 60_000 with a comment naming the measured worst case (8.5 s) and this bead. No assertion changed, global testTimeout unchanged, nothing skipped or retried.

protocol: As syzygy-4d15 (docs/evidence/poc-test-timeouts-2026-10-03.json): each measured full app-project run (npx vitest run --project @syzygy/three-surface-poc-app --reporter=json) ran concurrently with one companion full run, alongside the other overnight lane's load; load1m sampled at each run's end. Timeout classifier: failure message starting 'Error: STACK_TRACE_ERROR' or containing 'timed out in'.

before.source: syzygy-4d15's raw run reports (3 before-phase and 10 after-phase full runs, each with a companion). governance-inputs.test.ts and governance-inputs.ts had the same blobs at 0170bfc, fd8d1a2 and this branch's base (f9fecad8e47308d1588aae9f1bb17b316f6432f7 and 5f124ffda76c5cabfec4f7eb1fc91858373009ff), and the decisions directory held 118 .md records at both ends.

after.statement: 10 consecutive full app-project runs under the parallel-load protocol: the target test ran 20 times (10 measured, 10 companion), 0 timeouts, 0 failures, worst 8.2 s. governance-inputs.test.ts as a whole: 230 measured executions (23 x 10), 0 failures in measured or companion runs.
